shares_diluted.basis: ttm_shares_diluted = ytd_current (weighted average diluted shares for the current YTD period)

overrides_used.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-18, accession 0001628280-26-009057), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows: no share-based/stock compensation adjustment appears among the operating-activity reconciling items for FY2025, FY2024 or FY2023, and the Consolidated Statements of Changes in Stockholders' Equity show no stock-compensation credit to additional paid-in capital in FY2023-FY2025 (APIC flat at $23,764 thousand through FY2024-FY2025). EDGAR companyfacts' last filed ShareBasedCompensation values are $0 for FY2020 and FY2021 (10-Ks filed 2021-02-26 / 2022-02-22).

Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-18, accession 0001628280-26-009057), Consolidated Statements of Operations: 'Weighted average number of Common Stock shares outstanding - assuming dilution' 83,807 thousand for FY2025 (90,524 thousand FY2024, 93,923 thousand FY2023), all retroactively adjusted for the 10-for-1 forward stock split effected May 27, 2025. Under the two-class method this Common diluted line is the company-wide diluted denominator: it equals Common basic 73,658 thousand + Class B diluted 10,149 thousand, and FY2025 net income $570,582 thousand / 83,807 thousand shares = the reported diluted EPS of $6.81 — the Class B diluted line is a component of the Common diluted line, not additive to it.

ytd_current.note: share counts are weighted averages, not flows — used unprorated as the TTM denominator
